reasoning: Speed has units of meters per second. Dividing its change by elapsed time gives (m/s)/s = m/s². The earlier answer, option b, was graded Correct and matches the captured worked solution.

answers.ma_evidence:
Therefore, the appropriate unit for the rate of change of speed is

$$
\frac{(\frac{\text{m}}{\text{s}})}{\text{s}}=\frac{\text{m}}{{\text{s}}^{2}}.
$$

or, meters per square second.
